Simulated dataset for knockofftools

simdata.Rd

A synthetic dataset generated by the function generate_simdata(). It contains simulated Gaussian, binary, and survival outcomes along with covariates.

Usage

simdata

Format

A data frame with 2000 rows and 33 variables:

Yg

Continuous outcome

Yb

Binary outcome

Tc

Treatment indicator

X1

Covariate 1

X2

Covariate 2

X3

Covariate 3

X4

Covariate 4

Covariate 5

Covariate 6

Covariate 7
